name: Cyberjaya 21K 2026
short_description: Cyberjaya 21K 2026 is a 21.1 km half-marathon held on August 2, 2026 in Cyberjaya, Selangor, Malaysia.

Registration for this race is currently closed, and the listed price range was MYR 60.
